Evaluators were asked to judge each paraphrase pair on meaning (fidelity), surface similarity (diversity) and fluency using crowd‑sourced Amazon Mechanical Turk workers.

We ask human evaluators to compare systems on three different dimensions, according to the following instructions: Meaning. Which of the paraphrases better preserves the meaning of the original, without adding or losing information? Surface similarity. Which of the paraphrases is more similar compared to the original, using more similar phrasing or words? Fluency. Which text is a more fluent English sentence?
